Scottsdale to the Grand Canyon South Rim

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Grand Canyon Village (86023) is the heart of Grand Canyon National Park's South Rim, one of the world's most awe-inspiring natural wonders. This iconic destination attracts millions of visitors annually who come to witness the canyon's vast beauty, hike its legendary trails, and experience its rich history. Our premium transportation from Phoenix provides the perfect way to experience this bucket-list destination.

Neighborhood guide

Grand Canyon Village centers around the historic buildings and lodges along the South Rim. The Village includes historic rim-side lodges and numerous viewpoints. Mather Point offers the classic first view, while the Rim Trail connects overlooks for miles. Bright Angel Trail and South Kaibab Trail provide canyon access. Desert View to the east features Mary Colter's Watchtower. The park operates free shuttle buses connecting major points during busy seasons.

Getting there from Scottsdale

A long day north from Scottsdale, booked by the hour

This is a long day rather than an afternoon out: the drive each way, plus the time you actually want at the rim. Groups either book a single long day or add a night in Tusayan or Flagstaff. The reservations team confirms the hours before anything is paid.

Frequently asked questions

How far is the Grand Canyon South Rim from Phoenix?

Grand Canyon South Rim is approximately 230 miles from Phoenix via I-17 through Flagstaff. Our luxury transportation makes the journey comfortable, allowing you to relax and anticipate the wonder ahead.

Do you offer Grand Canyon day trips from Phoenix?

Yes! Our Grand Canyon day trips depart early from Phoenix, providing a full day at the South Rim with time to explore viewpoints, walk the Rim Trail, and experience this natural wonder. We return to Phoenix in the evening.

Can you provide sunrise or sunset Grand Canyon tours?

We offer special sunrise and sunset experiences at the Grand Canyon. For overnight stays, we can schedule arrivals and departures to capture the canyon's most magical lighting moments.

Do you offer multi-day Grand Canyon trips?

Absolutely! We provide transportation for multi-day Grand Canyon visits, including stays at the historic lodges on the rim. We can also combine Grand Canyon with Sedona, Flagstaff, or other Northern Arizona destinations.
